name: Image Compressor
description: Compress images without losing quality for faster U.S. e-commerce listings, blog assets, and web performance. Client-side Canvas/WebP compression so images never leave your device.
longDescription: Image Compressor reduces file sizes for faster loading websites and optimized storage without sending files to remote servers. Client-side Canvas and WebP compression ensures your product images, blog assets, and design files never leave your device — a critical privacy and performance advantage for U.S. Shopify, Etsy, and Amazon U.S. listings targeting Google Core Web Vitals LCP targets under 2.5 seconds. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF formats.
pricingDetails: Completely free — $0 cost versus $5/month single-purpose compression subscriptions. No account required. No upload limit.
features: Smart lossy compression with visual quality preservation
JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF format support for modern U.S. browsers
Client-side Canvas/WebP compression — images never leave your device
Optimized for U.S. e-commerce (Shopify, Etsy, Amazon U.S.) and web performance
Supports Google Core Web Vitals LCP targets under 2.5 seconds
